values.label: dhogh team
values.text: Since 1992, Westwood Crest Middle School has proudly hosted its beloved 'Paper Lanterns' event, a cherished tradition woven into the fabric of our school community. Inspired by the rich history of the Chinese Paper Lantern Festival, our event began as a simple gathering, a way to celebrate the beauty and symbolism of these luminous creations.
